label: Add the setting that dehoists the names of the members
summary: Adds column "dehoist" to "GuildModeration" when it does not have it

execute.description: add the column, off for the guilds that are there
execute.sql: ALTER TABLE "public"."GuildModeration" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "dehoist" bool NOT NULL DEFAULT false

postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'GuildModeration' AND column_name = 'dehoist') AS "result"
